description:
Upgrade your 2017-2026 Jeep Compass with OEDRO All-Weather Floor Mats, engineered for a precision fit using advanced 3D laser scanning technology. Made from recyclable TPE material, these liners feature deep channels, raised edges, cargo coverage, and seatback protection to defend your interior from water, mud, snow, and everyday messes while maintaining a sleek factory-style appearance.
Features
Custom Fit for 2017-2026 Jeep Compass: Designed specifically for 2017-2026 Jeep Compass (Not Fit 2017 First Generation Old Body Style), OEDRO floor mats use advanced 3D laser scanning technology to deliver a precise, glove-like fit while maintaining full pedal clearance for safer driving.
Complete Interior Protection with Cargo & Seatback Mats: Includes front and rear floor liners, cargo mat, and seatback protection to provide extended coverage beyond traditional floor mats, helping protect your Jeep Compass interior from dirt, scratches, spills, and daily wear.
Premium Recyclable TPE Material: Made from durable, recyclable TPE material, these floor liners are odorless, pet-friendly, flexible, and built to withstand extreme weather conditions while providing long-lasting interior protection.
Raised Edge Design for Enhanced Protection: Designed with high sidewalls and deep channels, these all-weather floor liners help trap dirt, moisture, and debris while reducing messes from daily driving, outdoor activities, and seasonal weather.
Stylish Design Meets Easy Maintenance: Inspired by Jeep Compass interior styling, the textured pattern enhances your vehicle’s appearance while providing a non-slip surface. Waterproof construction allows quick cleaning—simply remove, rinse, and reinstall.
2-year warranty. For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended
Fitment
